environment.description: NestJS microservice deployed on AWS ECS Fargate behind an Application Load Balancer with default security group allowing 0.0.0.0/0 inbound on port 443. No IP-based restrictions configured. The ALB target group performs health checks on /health and forwards all other traffic directly to the container on port 3000. Container runs Node.js 18 with default event loop settings. Network latency between client and ALB is <2ms from same region, enabling high-precision timing measurements.
